bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than A4 (over 30 litres) are not allowed, including rucksacks, hiking bags, sports bags and suitcases.
allowed: Bags up to A4 size (30 litres or less)
prohibited: Large umbrellas with a pointed metal section
bagPolicy.note: There are no lockers at the stadium. Some concert organisers set up a limited locker system, but not at every show. The list may change based on the organiser.

parking.note: Parking options and pricing are not specifically detailed. It is advised to use public transport to avoid congestion during major events.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by King Baudouin Stadium. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at King Baudouin Stadium varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: All events are accessible to people with reduced mobility, but the stands have no lift and are not wheelchair accessible.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in King Baudouin Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The stadium does not sell tickets itself, so buy and manage tickets through each event's organiser. If you bought a package, photo ID is usually required on the day to collect its contents.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Ten access gates lead into the stadium. At large events, your ticket assigns you an entrance door, usually the same color as your stand. Arrive at least one hour before the start and follow the organizer's instructions.
